scope: one metadata-only whole-store inventory, not a query candidate pool or quality/latency acceptance
expected_calibration: Two real-engine literal-row calibration tests must pass before capture: character counts/digests/exact exported fields and absent episode index keys. Initial missing-null fixture expectation is retained as setup failure, not product RED.
policy: One disposable full snapshot copy, no migration/reformation. Only row IDs, character counts and SHA256 values exported. Every completed metadata query flushed immediately. LIMIT completeness must be checked against separate table counts; missing/failed queries stay unknown. Characters are not UTF8 bytes. Do not infer actual query candidate counts or end-to-end cost from table inventory. No retries to select success.
